# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::badge`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

A static tag (`widget.badge`): 18 px high, radius 8, a one px tone border, 11 px Medium text
on a 16 px line, an optional leading status dot. Colours come from [`Tone`](tone.md#enum.Tone), the one recipe of
the status widgets. The word carries the meaning; the colour is not the only channel.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/badge.rs:1`
